name: Instalment
definition: Specifies the details of each successive payment in settlement of a debt or in an investment plan.

InitialNumberOfInstalment.name: Initial Number Of Instalment
InitialNumberOfInstalment.definition: Number of pre-paid instalment periods at the time an investment plan is created.

TotalNumberOfInstalment.name: Total Number Of Instalment
TotalNumberOfInstalment.definition: Total number of times the amount must be invested at the predefined frequency as of the start date of the investment plan.

PeriodUnit.name: Period Unit
PeriodUnit.definition: Period unit between consecutive payments (for example day, month, year).

NumberOfUnits.name: Number Of Units
NumberOfUnits.definition: Number of period units between consecutive payments.

SequenceIdentification.name: Sequence Identification
SequenceIdentification.definition: Specifies the progressive number of a single instalment.

InvestmentPlan.name: Investment Plan
InvestmentPlan.definition: Investment plan for which instalment information is provided.
